short_description: Artosia is a free program for a church's media desk. It puts song words, Bible verses and announcements on the projector during a service.
description:
Artosia is a free program for a church's media desk. It runs on Windows 10 or 11 and puts song words, Bible verses and announcements on the projector during a service.

Find a song by its title or by any line of its words. Typing mistakes are forgiven, and the matching line is shown. Find a Bible passage by its reference or by its words. Bibles are downloaded from free collections, each showing its own copyright line first, or opened from your church's own file.

Each service has a plan: songs, passages and announcements in order. Preview shows what comes next and Live shows what the room sees. Nothing reaches the projector until you press Show.

In Design you set the text's size, place and font over a colour, a picture, a looping video or a live camera, and a gallery of free backdrops is built in. Any projector or second screen works. A second window shows the band the words, what comes next and a clock.

During a service you can run Artosia from a phone on the church's Wi-Fi, joined with a four-digit code. It moves next and back, opens the plan and search, and sends a message or a countdown to the room. Announcement and birthday cards loop before the service. It can listen to the room through a microphone and offer the song being sung. The speech is read on the computer itself and nothing is sent anywhere. Artosia can also send the projector's picture to a live stream using your own stream address.

Artosia is free, with no account, no advertising and nothing collected. It is open source under GPL-3.0-or-later. The window speaks Indonesian, English, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French and Vietnamese. Your church's library is kept in the Documents folder, in a folder named Artosia, so it stays when the program is removed.
feature_1: Find a song by its title or any line of its words; typing mistakes are forgiven
feature_2: Find a Bible passage by its reference or by its words
feature_3: A plan for each service, with Preview beside Live
feature_4: Backgrounds: a colour, a picture, a looping video or a live camera
feature_5: Works with any projector or second screen, with a screen for the band
feature_6: A remote on your phone over the church's Wi-Fi
feature_7: Brings in songs from EasiSlides and OpenLyrics
feature_8: Free and open source, with no account and nothing collected
